summary: Full E2E test of Belly Darts League backend + frontend. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed covering league info, schedule, standings (all + monthly), player registration (fee tier + duplicate), auth gating (401/403/admin), admin CRUD for players/matches, match points computation (medley 2-0=3, 2-1=2, countup+1, halfit+1, max 5), and standings recompute including exclusion of non-official matches. Frontend: Home, Standings, Schedule (15 weeks, expandable), Rules, Register (submits & shows success with fee tier), and Admin flows all render and interact correctly with valid admin session cookie. Score entry, add player, delete match, and tab navigation all confirmed working end-to-end.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option> in matchday <select> (from x-source dynamic wrapper). Not user-facing but pollutes console.

critical_code_review_comments: Note: review request stated 'today is after Sep 12 2026' but system clock is Sep 10 2026, so new public registrations currently return early tier ($100). This is correct per compute_fee logic; the test was adjusted to be date-adaptive.

server.py: seed_data uses random and creates ~6 weeks of matches idempotently only when db.players is empty — good. Consider seeding user_sessions for the admin email so real Google OAuth flow is the only path (already the case).
Standings endpoint recomputes _points_for as fallback if points_a/points_b missing — good defensive coding.
Public GET /api/players exposes emails/phones/paid/fee to anyone (no auth). Consider redacting sensitive fields on public endpoint (minor privacy).
